summary: Verified the iter-229 frontend bug fix: adding `useEffect` to React imports in DraftTab.tsx. League Administration → Drafts tab now loads cleanly without the previous `useEffect is not defined` ReferenceError. All smoke-test elements render correctly. The 'What if?' preview banner code path was verified via code review (live trigger was unreachable because the only draft in chriszarek's league is `status=completed`, and the edit pencil button is intentionally gated to `status === 'scheduled'`).

evidence: Line 10 of DraftTab.tsx confirmed: `import { useState, useEffect } from "react";`
Playwright loaded /commissioner/settings → Draft tab. page.on('pageerror') captured ZERO errors. page.on('console',error) captured ZERO non-401 errors.
Drafts tab body rendered completely (Create Draft form, eligibility checkboxes, DraftOrderConfigCard, Scheduled Drafts list).

edit_dialog_what_if_banner.status: PARTIAL — code verified, live trigger blocked by data
code_review: useEffect hook (lines 121-140) correctly debounces 250ms and calls GET /drafts/{editingDraftId}/edit-preview?total_rounds={newRounds}.
Effect cleanup cancels stale requests via `cancelled` flag + clearTimeout — race-condition safe.
Banner (lines 1194-1240) conditionally renders only when `editPreview && editPreview.new_rounds !== editPreview.original_rounds` — correctly hides on no-op.
data-testid='edit-draft-rounds-preview' is set on the banner container (line 1201).
Pencil/edit button at line 962-972 is gated on `draft.status === 'scheduled'` — by design completed drafts cannot be edited.
edit_dialog_what_if_banner.live_test_blocker: chriszarek's only draft in 'Zarek's Frozen' is status=completed (Untitled draft, 5 rounds, Snake) — no edit pencil rendered. Admin account landed in a League Setup Wizard modal that blocked the Drafts tab in 'Stat Chasers Roto'.

regression_edit_preview_endpoint.note: Iter 228q pytest already verified 35/35 (see iteration_114.json). Backend file drafts.py is untouched in this iter.

action_items: OPTIONAL: To enable live UI regression of the 'What if?' banner in future test runs, seed at least one draft with status='scheduled' in the chriszarek demo league, OR provide a flag to bypass the setup wizard for admin@dynastydreams.com so its leagues are reachable.
critical_code_review_comments: DraftTab.tsx is 1575 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider extracting the Edit Draft dialog (lines ~1100-1280) and the Scheduled Drafts table (lines ~900-1080) into their own components; this would also have prevented the missing-import regression by reducing surface area.

File starts with `// @ts-nocheck` — typescript safety is fully disabled, which is exactly why a missing-import like `useEffect` slipped past compile-time checks. Recommend incrementally removing @ts-nocheck on extracted child components.
Effect cancellation pattern (lines 125-139) is correct, but consider moving the debounce timeout into a constant (e.g., EDIT_PREVIEW_DEBOUNCE_MS = 250) for readability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on testable scope (bug fix + smoke flow). Edit-dialog live banner not exercised due to test-data constraints; code-level review PASS.

rca of the issue.bug: ReferenceError: useEffect is not defined when opening League Administration → Drafts tab.
rca of the issue.root_cause: Iter 228q introduced a new useEffect hook (lines 121-140) for the 'What if?' debounced /edit-preview call, but the React import on line 10 of DraftTab.tsx only imported `useState`. Since the file has `// @ts-nocheck`, the missing import was not caught at build time and only surfaced at runtime when the component mounted.
rca of the issue.fix_applied_by_main_agent: Added `useEffect` to the named imports on line 10: `import { useState, useEffect } from "react";`
rca of the issue.verification: Playwright run navigated to /commissioner/settings → Draft tab and captured zero pageerror events; the tab body rendered all expected sections.
rca of the issue.mitigation_recommendation: Either remove `// @ts-nocheck` from this file (or its extracted children) so TypeScript catches missing imports, or add an ESLint rule `react-hooks/rules-of-hooks` + `no-undef` over the tabs/* directory.
